decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds directly on the established machining offer and fits the stated push for smarter automation, so it draws on existing know-how and service infrastructure at low incremental cost and gives no shortfall signal that would trigger problemistic search after only one year.

The dual-table loading system is a close extension of the core business that shares components and service resources, so the slack carried by the established offer easily covers it while early results remain uncertain.

Although the dispensing machine is distant from the core offer and riskier, management presents it as a flagship of its strategic direction with its own web page, so after one year it would tolerate uncertain results rather than drop it before measuring them against aspirations.
